review_candidates.title: Light Current Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Backed by partnerships with global leaders in physical security and a team with over 20 years of combined experience in IT, low current, and security systems, INT builds solutions that evolve with technology and customer needs. Role Description The Light Current Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining low current systems such as security, surveillance, access control, fire detection, data networks, and related infrastructure.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Backed by partnerships with global leaders in physical security and a team with over 20 years of combined experience in IT, low current, and security systems, INT builds solutions that evolve with technology and customer needs. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing client requirements, conducting site surveys, preparing technical designs and shop drawings, and selecting appropriate equipment and components. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong low current and security systems skills, including design, implementation, integration, and maintenance of CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, fire alarm, and structured cabling systems. Candidates should possess communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to listen to clients, clarify requirements, present practical designs, and manage changes during the approval process.
